package answer

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

const (
	assessmentKindSingleChoice   = "single_choice"
	assessmentKindOrdering       = "ordering"
	assessmentKindClassification = "classification"
)

type taskTestAnswerPayload struct {
	Answers []taskTestAnswerPayloadItem `json:"answers"`
}

type taskTestAnswerPayloadItem struct {
	TestID            string                           `json:"test_id"`
	VariantID         string                           `json:"variant_id,omitempty"`
	OrderedVariantIDs []string                         `json:"ordered_variant_ids,omitempty"`
	GroupAssignments  []taskTestGroupAssignmentPayload `json:"group_assignments,omitempty"`
}

type taskTestGroupAssignmentPayload struct {
	VariantID string `json:"variant_id"`
	GroupID   string `json:"group_id"`
}

func decodeTaskTestAnswerPayload(task *TaskMetadata, payload json.RawMessage) (*taskTestAnswerPayload, error) {
	if task == nil || len(task.Tests) == 0 || len(bytes.TrimSpace(payload)) == 0 {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(payload))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var body taskTestAnswerPayload
	if err := decoder.Decode(&body); err != nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); err != io.EOF {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if len(body.Answers) != len(task.Tests) {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	testsByID := make(map[string]TaskTestMetadata, len(task.Tests))
	for _, test := range task.Tests {
		testID := strings.TrimSpace(test.ID)
		if testID == "" {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		testsByID[testID] = test
	}

	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(body.Answers))
	for index := range body.Answers {
		item := &body.Answers[index]
		item.TestID = strings.TrimSpace(item.TestID)
		item.VariantID = strings.TrimSpace(item.VariantID)
		if item.TestID == "" {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if _, exists := seen[item.TestID]; exists {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		seen[item.TestID] = struct{}{}

		test, exists := testsByID[item.TestID]
		if !exists {
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		switch assessmentKindForTest(task, test) {
		case assessmentKindSingleChoice:
			if item.VariantID == "" || item.OrderedVariantIDs != nil || item.GroupAssignments != nil {
				return nil, domain.ErrValidation
			}
			if !testContainsVariant(test, item.VariantID) {
				return nil, domain.ErrValidation
			}
		case assessmentKindOrdering:
			if item.VariantID != "" || len(item.OrderedVariantIDs) == 0 || item.GroupAssignments != nil {
				return nil, domain.ErrValidation
			}
			if len(item.OrderedVariantIDs) != len(test.Variants) {
				return nil, domain.ErrValidation
			}
			seenVariants := make(map[string]struct{}, len(item.OrderedVariantIDs))
			for variantIndex := range item.OrderedVariantIDs {
				item.OrderedVariantIDs[variantIndex] = strings.TrimSpace(item.OrderedVariantIDs[variantIndex])
				variantID := item.OrderedVariantIDs[variantIndex]
				if variantID == "" || !testContainsVariant(test, variantID) {
					return nil, domain.ErrValidation
				}
				if _, duplicate := seenVariants[variantID]; duplicate {
					return nil, domain.ErrValidation
				}
				seenVariants[variantID] = struct{}{}
			}
		case assessmentKindClassification:
			if item.VariantID != "" || item.OrderedVariantIDs != nil || len(item.GroupAssignments) == 0 {
				return nil, domain.ErrValidation
			}
			if len(item.GroupAssignments) != len(test.Variants) {
				return nil, domain.ErrValidation
			}
			seenVariants := make(map[string]struct{}, len(item.GroupAssignments))
			for assignmentIndex := range item.GroupAssignments {
				assignment := &item.GroupAssignments[assignmentIndex]
				assignment.VariantID = strings.TrimSpace(assignment.VariantID)
				assignment.GroupID = strings.TrimSpace(assignment.GroupID)
				if assignment.VariantID == "" || assignment.GroupID == "" ||
					!testContainsVariant(test, assignment.VariantID) || !testContainsGroup(test, assignment.GroupID) {
					return nil, domain.ErrValidation
				}
				if _, duplicate := seenVariants[assignment.VariantID]; duplicate {
					return nil, domain.ErrValidation
				}
				seenVariants[assignment.VariantID] = struct{}{}
			}
		default:
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}

	return &body, nil
}

func testContainsVariant(test TaskTestMetadata, variantID string) bool {
	for _, variant := range test.Variants {
		if strings.TrimSpace(variant.ID) == variantID {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func testContainsGroup(test TaskTestMetadata, groupID string) bool {
	for _, group := range test.Groups {
		if strings.TrimSpace(group.ID) == groupID {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func assessmentKindForTest(task *TaskMetadata, test TaskTestMetadata) string {
	kind := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(test.Kind))
	if kind != "" {
		return kind
	}
	if task == nil {
		return ""
	}
	switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(task.TaskKind)) {
	case "test":
		return assessmentKindSingleChoice
	case assessmentKindOrdering:
		return assessmentKindOrdering
	case assessmentKindClassification:
		return assessmentKindClassification
	default:
		return ""
	}
}

func isStructuredAssessment(task *TaskMetadata) bool {
	if task == nil {
		return false
	}
	if task.Type == 11 || task.Type == 12 || task.Type == 13 {
		return true
	}
	switch strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(task.TaskKind)) {
	case "test", assessmentKindOrdering, assessmentKindClassification:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}
